clips.title: The story
paras: Moonrage worgen haunt North Tide's Hollow, a clearing just north of the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Loyal to the rogue Archmage Arugal, they use it as a base to stalk the coastal woods.

North Tide's Hollow lies in dense timber north of the Forsaken settlement of the Sepulcher. The savage Moonrage pack holds the hollow, worgen brought into Lordaeron by Archmage Arugal's reckless sorcery. Crude shelters scattered through the hollow offer the hardy beasts little more than bare necessities, yet give them a forward staging ground close to Forsaken travel routes.

The Moonrage worgen answer to a sinister will from Shadowfang Keep, unlike ordinary wilderness predators. Near the western shoreline and Silverpine's main road, they menace Forsaken couriers and patrols moving through the region.
